provider.readme:
# Google Gemini
Google's flagship chat web UI at [gemini.google.com](https://gemini.google.com). The browser bridge drives the logged-in Google account session — your existing Google One AI / Workspace subscription is the rate limiter, no per-token API fees and no Google AI Studio key required.
**Models typically exposed** (subject to discovery on first login):
- Gemini 2.5 Pro — flagship reasoning + 2M-token context - Gemini 2.5 Flash — fast, low-latency tier - Gemini 2.5 Deep Research — multi-step web research
**First-time setup:** sign in once with your regular Google account; the bridge reuses the cookies on every subsequent chat. No phone verification beyond what Google itself requires.
